resources.string: Where this day happened. The diary has no internet and doesn\'t know where you are, so you write the place yourself.
Both pages of this day are full
Turn the cover with your finger
Voice can\'t be recorded without microphone permission
Write and draw with your finger. The eraser only removes fresh ink.
Diaries will stand on a shelf. Without a name it\'s simply “Diary”.
Tap a spine to take the diary out. Long-press to rename or erase.
The diary will open without a code. It stays encrypted on the phone.
Turn the wheels and tap “Lock in”.
Code: %s.\n\nIt can\'t be reset or recovered. If it\'s forgotten, the diary can only be erased together with everything written in it.
The code can\'t be reset: without it the writing can\'t be decrypted. The only option is to erase this diary completely and start a new one.
All days, photos, voice notes and the cover will be gone forever. This can\'t be undone (except from a backup).
The backup is a single file encrypted with this password. Keep it anywhere (USB stick, computer). It can\'t be opened without the password — don\'t forget it.
The diary from the backup will appear on the shelf next to the others (without a lock — set one if needed).
This isn\'t a diary backup, or the file is damaged
Search by words from the text or place, a number (“11” — the 11th or November), a date (“12.03”), a month (“March”), a year (“2025”) or a period: “week”, “month”, “year”. Combine them: “sea July”.
Days with entries are circled. Tap a day to turn to it — or an empty one to write it.
Black glass, clean lines, a soft glow
While the ink is fresh, the text can be edited freely. Dry ink can\'t be changed — only crossed out (you can always add more).
Clock and battery — only by swiping down
Everything is stored only on this phone, encrypted. The diary has no internet access.

Take a page with your finger in its outer third (not at the very edge — that's the phone's back gesture) and pull: from the right — forward, from the left — back. Let go halfway and the page either settles or falls back, like a real one.

The cover turns the same way, only heavier. The diary opens right at the bookmark (or at today — as chosen in Settings).

The phone's back gesture closes the diary (to the cover), once more — to the shelf. The gear at the bottom shows up after a touch.

Tap a line — the keyboard appears and the whole page slides above it (the text never leaves the paper).

Each day has two pages. When the first is full, the diary turns to the second by itself. There's no more room per day — so it doesn't turn into a novel.

Place (top right) — tap to write it in. The diary has no internet, so it doesn't know where you are.

The gear → “Write with a pen”: write and draw with your finger over the page — underline, circle, doodle. Slow strokes are thicker, fast ones thinner.\n\nThree widths, an eraser, undo and redo. There\'s no handwriting recognition: you know what it says.

Fresh ink is bright and the text can be corrected. After a day (or a week — in Settings) it dries: it gets a little duller and can no longer be changed.

Dry text can only be crossed out: hold a finger on a word and slide along the line. In “Sheet” the words are struck through with pencil; in “Glass” a frosted glass drop covers them.

You can always add to a day — new text goes after the dry part.

The gear → “Add a photo”: one photo per day. It becomes part of the page: black-and-white under glass in “Glass”, a pencil sketch in “Sheet”. Tap to see it bigger.

The gear → “Record voice”: one recording per day (up to 5 minutes). The round button plays / pauses; tap the strip to seek.

Remove a photo or recording by swiping left (with “Undo”).

The ribbon is sewn to the spine; its tip hangs from under the book on the left. Pull the tip down — the ribbon lies on this page. Pull it again — it\'s removed.\n\nWhen the bookmark is on another page, tap the tip and the diary turns there.

Search — the ribbon at the top of the page: pull it down. Words, numbers, dates, months, years, place, and “week”, “month”, “year”. Tap a result — the diary turns to that day and highlights the word. Photos and Audio — only photos (with a slideshow) or only recordings.

The calendar icon next to the search field: month pages, days with entries are circled. You can also open an empty past day to write it.

If something was written on this day a year (or more) ago, today's page has a folded corner at the bottom.

The gear → “Set a lock”: turn the four wheels and lock in. From then on the diary opens only with that code.

The code can't be reset or recovered. If it's forgotten, the diary can only be erased.

Everything written is always encrypted on the phone (even without a lock). While a locked diary is open, screenshots are disabled; as soon as the app goes to the background, it closes.

The gear → “New diary”. With more than one, a shelf with spines appears. Tap to take a diary out; long-press to rename or erase.

Each diary has its own cover, lock and bookmark.

The gear on the shelf — new diary, backup and general settings (for all diaries). The gear inside a diary — only its own.

The gear → “Backup”: the whole diary (days, photos, voice, cover) in one file, encrypted with a password you choose.\n\nOn a new phone: The gear → “Restore from backup”, pick the file and enter the password.
No room for a photo — shorten this day\'s text
No room for a recording — shorten this day\'s text
Off — the whole page is for text
Off — the recording space goes to text
Drag your finger over dry words to strike them out. Tap the icon again to leave
This day already has a recording — swipe it left to record a new one
Tear out the page — forever, no way back
The page has dried — only the pencil now
Ink dries after a day: then the page can\'t be changed — no text, photo or voice. The pencil stays, or the page can be torn out (hold the bottom-left corner and drag up).
Tap a diary to open its own settings (cover, name, lock, photos and voice, backup).
The diary is locked — its settings appear once you open it with the code
All photos of the last week
One random photo from each week of the month
One random photo from each month of the year
Only photos. Type “week”, “month” or “year” — or “best of the month”: one random photo from each week. Words and dates search the notes of those days.
Only voice recordings, listen right here. Type “week”, “month”, “year”, a date or a word from that day’s note.
Carry the place to the next day
A new page takes the place from the previous one. Turn off for a travel diary
Allow the camera to take a photo of the day
